spec.claim_summary: Buying ether when its 50-day simple moving average crosses above its 200-day simple moving average on a closing basis and selling 180 days later.

claimed.other: the largest and only loss following a Golden Cross signal is less than one percent

assumptions: Ether / ETH interpreted as Binance spot ETHUSDT.
'50-day' and '200-day' simple moving averages interpreted as SMA(50) and SMA(200) on 1d bars.
'On a closing basis' matches engine evaluation on bar closes with fill at next open.
Long direction implied by holding after the cross and selling 180 days later; no explicit buy/long word.
Exit 'Sell 180 days later' encoded as max_hold_bars 180 on 1d; no stop, target or trailing stop was stated.

evidence.quote: Ether's 50-day sma crosses above its 200-day sma
The average trade of +59.2% in just 180 days
the largest and only loss following a Golden Cross signal is less than one percent
